title: Background Agents in Slack
description: Launch Cursor Background Agents directly from Slack by mentioning @Cursor. Enables seamless integration between Slack conversations and AI coding agents.

title: Auto Model Selection Task-Based Routing in VS Code
description: Auto model selection now routes based on your task type in VS Code for optimal performance.

title: Semantic Issue Search in Copilot Chat
description: New semantic search capability in Copilot Chat helps find and understand issues more effectively.

title: Version 0.132.0 - Python SDK Auth and TUI Improvements
description: Python SDK now supports first-class authentication, including API key login, ChatGPT browser and device-code flows, account inspection, and logout APIs. Python turn APIs are easier to use for text-only workflows. `codex exec resume` now accepts `--output-schema`. TUI startup is faster with batched terminal capability probes. Remote executor registration can now use standard Codex auth. App-server turns can preserve requested image fidelity.

title: Version 2.1.145 - Agent JSON Export and Status Line Enhancement
description: Added `claude agents --json` to list live sessions as JSON. Added `agent_id` and `parent_agent_id` attributes to OTEL spans. Status line JSON now includes GitHub repo and PR information.

community_feedback.quote: 2026 is where it gets very real because if claude code keeps improving at this speed, we're looking at a fundamental shift in software development

title: Version 2.1.144 - Background Session Resume and Plugin Browse Enhancements
description: Added `/resume` support for background sessions. Added elapsed duration to background subagent completion notifications. `/plugin` browse now shows last update time.

title: Apply Code Review Feedback with Copilot Cloud Agent
description: Easily apply Copilot code review feedback with Copilot cloud agent integration.

title: Gemini 3.5 Flash Generally Available
description: Gemini 3.5 Flash model is now generally available for GitHub Copilot users.

title: BugBot - Automatic Code Review
description: BugBot automatically reviews PRs and code changes, providing automated feedback and issue detection. Achieves nearly 80% bug resolution rate and reviews 2M+ PRs monthly.

community_feedback.quote: Cursor claims teams save 40% of time spent on code reviews with BugBot

title: One-Click Fixes for Failing Actions
description: Copilot cloud agent now provides one-click fixes for failing GitHub Actions.

title: Fast Cost-Efficient Models for Simple Tasks
description: Copilot cloud agent now uses fast, cost-efficient models for simple tasks.

title: Contextual Questions on Web
description: Ask questions in context with Copilot on the web.

title: Copilot Spaces API Generally Available
description: Copilot Spaces API is now generally available, enabling programmatic management of shared context.

title: Remote Control for CLI Sessions Generally Available
description: Remote control for Copilot CLI sessions now generally available on mobile, web, and VS Code.

title: Version 0.131.0 - TUI Enhancements, Plugin Workflows, and Remote Features
description: TUI now offers richer session controls and display with data-driven service-tier commands, blended token usage, permissions/approval mode, and responsive Markdown tables. `@` mentions now search files, directories, plugins, and skills in one picker. Plugin workflows gained marketplace CLI commands, version-aware sharing, and share checkout. Remote workflows now support daemon-managed `codex remote-control`, runtime enable/disable APIs, and status reads. Python SDK moved to `openai-codex` / `openai_codex` with pinned runtime-generated types. Added `codex doctor` for diagnostics.

title: GPT-5.3-Codex Base Model for Business and Enterprise
description: GPT-5.3-Codex is now the base model for Copilot Business and Enterprise.

title: Version 2.1.143 - Plugin Dependency Enforcement and Worktree Options
description: Added plugin dependency enforcement with disable-chain hints. Added `worktree.bgIsolation: "none"` setting for background sessions to edit working copy directly.

title: Background Agents Available to Everyone
description: Background Agents feature rolled out to all users, allowing AI to work on tasks asynchronously while users continue coding.

title: Copilot Memory User Preferences for Pro and Pro+
description: Copilot Memory now supports user preferences for Pro and Pro+ users.

title: Team-Level Copilot Usage Metrics via API
description: Team-level Copilot usage metrics now available via API for better tracking and management.

title: Copilot App Technical Preview
description: GitHub Copilot app is now available in technical preview.

title: Work with Codex from Anywhere
description: You can now use Codex from the ChatGPT mobile app by connecting it to a Mac running the Codex app. Codex runs from the connected host, so the same projects, files, credentials, plugins, skills, and configuration are available from your phone. This launch also includes Hooks general availability, Codex access tokens for trusted automation, and Enterprise admin setup guidance.

title: Copilot CLI Agent and Unified Sessions in JetBrains
description: Introducing Copilot CLI agent and unified sessions view in GitHub Copilot for JetBrains IDEs.

title: Start Cloud Agent Tasks via REST API
description: Start Copilot cloud agent tasks via the REST API for programmatic control.

title: Claude Opus 4.7 Fast Mode
description: Claude Opus 4.7 (fast mode) is now available in Windsurf, featuring full intelligence of Opus 4.7 with ~2.5x higher output speeds.

title: Devin Local Agent Update (v2026.5.26)
description: The bundled Devin Local agent updated to version 2026.5.26 as part of Windsurf Next, which includes integration with local and cloud agents working together.
